checks.name: Execution Profile capability display
checks.detail: The exact qualified profile shows its profile and qualification digests, one read-only operation, local-process destination, credential NONE, expiry, broker-only authority, and the explicit harness-MCP-unsupported limitation.

checks.name: Tool Grant read-only history
checks.detail: The existing Factory Configuration surface shows the current qualified grant and immutable revoked predecessor with exact grant/tool digests and safe remediation.

checks.name: Readiness and revoked currentness
checks.detail: After revocation, a fresh readiness assessment marks both the exact profile and exact governed MCP fixture missing and instructs the operator to replace the stale/revoked grant, then create a new immutable profile and Factory version. The screenshot shows the selected frozen Factory version; the semantic capture verified the rows below the viewport.

checks.name: 390px usability
checks.detail: Viewport width, body scroll width, and document scroll width were all 390px; no horizontal overflow was present.

checks.name: Refresh persistence
checks.evidence: fresh agent-browser session and semantic snapshot
checks.detail: A fresh browser session retained Factory Version 6 and recomputed the revoked profile/grant currentness from Convex state. The shell header continued to show the workspace's default MissionControl repository card while the Factory panel remained selected on the separate public spectrum-design-data-mc-demo repository.

checks.name: Attempt call, receipt, denial, and unavailable-server presentation
checks.detail: These states are exercised through the integrated read model, UI component tests, broker tests, and Factory qualification. No browser-dispatched live Attempt or external MCP server was claimed.

limitations: No external transmission, credential, service cost, or production/internal data was used.
The screenshot viewport does not display every readiness row; semantic browser evidence records the exact currentness text.
The shell's left repository card identifies the workspace default; it is not the selected repository inside Workspaces & Repositories.
Browser verification does not upgrade the fixture to a real admitted MCP service.
